# has distribution

Relates a package to one of its concrete distribution artifacts. Non-functional: a package may have multiple distributions (tarball, wheel, binary, container).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasDistribution>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasDistribution`  

*object property* · domain `gmeow:Package` · range `gmeow:Distribution`
